name: Engine8
summary: Engine8 is an emergency services simulation that combines the dispatch centre and incident command in one game. Emergency calls come in at real addresses on a map built from OpenStreetMap and official terrain data, starting with the district of Freising in Bavaria, Germany. The player alerts units from real fire and rescue stations with their actual vehicles, then takes over at the scene: dismounting crews, fetching equipment, positioning the turntable ladder, sending breathing apparatus teams into buildings and building the water supply from hydrants, open water or tanker shuttles. Fires spread and smoke develops room by room; the rescue service takes over rescued patients and transports them to hospital. Calls use German alarm keywords and FMS radio status. The game can be played alone or in online co-op in a shared world. It runs natively on Windows, macOS and Linux.
